app.title: CRE Agent Studio
app.signIn: Sign in with your CRE account
app.noAccess: Your account has no access to CRE Agent Studio. Ask a Studio admin to add you.
app.tagline: Build, test and approve CRE agents.
app.pageFailedHint: Something went wrong while drawing this page. Your saved work is safe. Try again, or reload the Studio.

knowledge.title: Knowledge Library
knowledge.intro: Device protocols, clinical rules and reference documents. Uploading a spreadsheet does not create an approved rule: every revision is reviewed and approved separately.
knowledge.name: Name

wizard.title: Import a revision of {{name}}
wizard.chooseFile: Choose an .xlsx or .csv file, up to 10 MB. Only values are read; formulas are not run.
wizard.previewNote: {{count}} data rows below the header row.

revision.title: {{name}}, revision {{no}}
revision.rowsWithErrors: {{count}} rows have errors. Fix the file and import a new revision.
revision.approvedBy: Approved by a different user than the author.
revision.independentNote: The author of a revision cannot approve it.

agents.title: Agents
agents.intro: Clinical decision support and voice scheduling agents. Build the graph, set prohibitions, compile, then freeze a candidate for testing and independent approval.
agents.name: Name

editor.addHint: Click a block to add it, then connect its exits.
editor.noSelection: Select a block to edit it.
editor.label: Label
editor.draftPrompt: Prompt text (saved to the Prompt Builder before release)
editor.reviewed: Mapping confirmed by a clinical reviewer
editor.stale: Someone else saved this agent; reload to continue.
editor.notCompiled: Compile to check the graph before freezing a candidate.
editor.phoneReadOnly: The graph is edited on a tablet or computer. On a phone you can review it, compile and see test runs.

profiles.title: Clinic & exam profiles
profiles.intro: Pin site, department, the exact RIS procedure, screening questions and the scheduling horizon for a voice scheduling agent. Each change is a new revision approved by a different user.
profiles.name: Name

runs.title: Test runs
runs.intro: Run a frozen candidate on test values. Only entered values are used; an empty field is missing, never false. Findings show the exact rows used and stay for clinician review.
runs.voiceLater: Voice agents run on calls, not here.
runs.noCandidate: Freeze a candidate in the editor first.
runs.patientHint: Leave a field empty when the value isn't known. It counts as missing, not as no.
runs.emptyResult: Choose a candidate, enter a case and run it. The result and every step appear here.
runs.missingText: Paused: the run needs {{fields}}. Enter the value and run again.
runs.aiNotConfigured: AI wording isn't set up yet, so the summary lists the findings as they are.
runs.noteHint: Free text, e.g. the referral. Read only by an AI patient information step; values it finds are shown with the words they came from.
runs.fromNoteByAi: from the clinical note, by AI

summaryAi.not_configured: AI wording isn't set up yet, so the summary lists the findings as they are.
summaryAi.used: Written by AI from the findings above. The findings are the result; check the summary against them.
summaryAi.unavailable: The AI service didn't answer, so the summary lists the findings as they are.
summaryAi.rejected: The AI summary was not used because it contained a value that isn’t in the findings. The findings are listed as they are.

findings.PROTOCOL_CONFLICT: {{count}} protocol rows match: choose one with clinical review
findings.PROTOCOL_NO_MATCH: No protocol row matches; none is chosen by default
findings.GUIDANCE_CONFLICT: {{count}} guidance rows match: review them together

notes.aiSynthesis: AI wording isn't set up yet; the summary lists the findings as they are.
notes.aiExtraction: AI extraction isn't set up yet; only entered values were used.
notes.knowledge: The knowledge revision is {{status}}, so this step can't run.
notes.knowledgeMissing: The knowledge revision is not available, so this step can't run.

extraction.used: AI found in the clinical note: {{fields}}.
extraction.nothing_found: AI found no further values in the clinical note.
extraction.no_note: No clinical note was given; only entered values were used.
extraction.not_configured: AI extraction isn't set up yet; only entered values were used.
extraction.unavailable: The AI service didn't answer; only entered values were used.
extraction.rejected: The AI reply was not usable; only entered values were used.
extraction.budget: The AI call limit was reached; only entered values were used.

synthesis.not_configured: AI wording isn't set up yet; the summary lists the findings as they are.
synthesis.unavailable: The AI service didn't answer; the summary lists the findings as they are.
synthesis.rejected: The AI summary was not used; the summary lists the findings as they are.
synthesis.budget: The AI call limit was reached; the summary lists the findings as they are.
synthesis.prompt_unavailable: This step has no prompt text (only a Prompt Builder link); the summary lists the findings as they are.

inspector.title: Run Inspector
inspector.intro: Every test and clinical run, with the exact version, inputs, rules evaluated and evidence. Open a run to see each step.

release.title: Versions and release
release.intro: A frozen version goes live only after its test cases pass and a different user approves it. One version is active at a time; activating an earlier approved version rolls back.
release.voiceLater: Voice agents are released after call testing, which is not available yet.
release.noVersions: No frozen versions yet. Freeze a candidate in the editor.
release.notOwn: You froze this version; another approver must approve it.
release.needTests: Run the test cases and get them all passing first.
release.firstVersion: Nothing is active yet: everything is new.

problems.blocked: Expected {{expected}} to be withheld by a prohibition

release.testCasesIntro: Saved patient situations with the result the agent must give. They run on every version before approval: cover a match, missing data, no match and conflicting rows.
release.findingsHint: Leave all unticked to check the result only.
release.noCases: No test cases yet. Add one, or save a test run as a test case.
